THE LAST PLAYER STANDING

Two truths.
One lie.

A little honesty. A little deception. A room full of friends.

Rules & quick guide

2–8 players, up to 2 viewers, 10 people total. Start with 3–6 points. Enter two truths followed by a lie in the red third box. Every device gets its own random order, fixed until the next turn.

Correct +1, wrong −1. Each round starts with 1 skip for scores 1–5, or 2 for scores 6+. Skipping or missing uses one skip. Once used up, a missed answer costs −1. At zero you’re eliminated; the last survivor wins.

Presenters get 90 seconds and one 30-second extension. Start guessing triggers a 3-second countdown, then the chosen guess timer. Keep choices secret and stay quiet while presenting. Chat pauses during guessing.

Away presenters are skipped. At the start of your fourth away round, you move to viewers; if both viewer seats are full, you’re removed. Tied scores rank by average speed on correct guesses.

Two Truths & a Lie · made for your people
